subject: Marine works - Southwestern Shore - Blandford, NS
text:
Marine works - Southwestern Shore - Blandford, NS
Ferry terminal construction underway in Blandford, NS. daily during daylight hours.
Work area demarcated by two white flashing lights installed on the west end of the new wharf structure.
Multiple work boats, tug and barges will be on site monitoring VHF Ch 16 and sailing daily between Blandford, NS and Big Tancook Island, NS.
Minimum wash and wide berth requested.
                                                    Cancels NW-M-1690-24
